decisions.reason: As a large established machinery producer, the firm is likely to keep the coolant pressure booster system because it is closely related to its existing fluid-handling know-how and can be refined through normal customer feedback and engineering learning.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's adjacent mechanical-process capabilities, and despite somewhat higher technical and service demands, the firm likely has enough internal knowledge to improve rather than abandon it.
Coolant nozzles are a highly related, modular extension of the firm's existing competence base, so management would usually retain them as an easy-to-assimilate complement to the wider product range.
The scraper belt chip conveyor builds directly on established conveying and machine-accessory knowledge, making it a product the firm can interpret, support, and incrementally improve with low risk.

The magnetic belt chip conveyor is still close to the firm's core machinery capabilities, and a large German manufacturer would typically keep such a related offering while learning from early application results.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is a standard adjacent product for this kind of machinery firm, so absorptive capacity is high and management would be inclined to continue it rather than withdraw it quickly.
